species.name: Fernling
species.personality: Curious and brave; it tests every new path before the rest of the team.
species.desc: A little fox that naps beneath the ferns and wakes at the first rustle.
species.encounterHint: Start in the meadow tall grass, close to camp.

regions.name: Dusk Trail
regions.subtitle: A quiet path at the edge of evening.
regions.desc: Meet a traveler, listen to a mystery and explore at your own pace.

spore-guard.name: Spore guard
spore-guard.intro: It curls behind a cloud of spores. Right after it braces, your attack is halved, so use that turn to Guard or heal and save your elemental move for when it opens up.

rolling-charge.name: Rolling charge
rolling-charge.intro: It gathers strength, then lands a heavy blow. Watch the line under the log and Guard when the heavy blow is next.

frost-chorus.name: Frost chorus
frost-chorus.intro: It keeps using its elemental move. A teammate that resists it, or healing between volleys, makes the difference.

tidal-current.name: Tidal current
tidal-current.intro: A wave builds before the crash. Use the quiet turn to heal or prepare, then Guard when the line calls out the heavy blow.
